2607.17719.title: SR-Agent: An Experience-Driven Agentic Framework for Post-Ranking Strategies Refinement in E-Commerce Recommendation
2607.17719.paper_summary: User experience is a first-class objective in industrial e-commerce recommender systems (RS). Post-ranking strategies, which govern diversity, similarity, and exposure over a ranked list, are widely deployed in industrial RS for their simplicity and low serving cost. However, as the online recommendation environment evolves continuously, these statically configured strategies gradually become stale, degrading the user experience. Refining them typically relies on manual inspection, diagnosis, and updates, a process that is slow, costly, and hard to reuse. Although recent LLM-based agents (e.g., RecUserSim, SimUSER, and Self-EvolveRec) offer promising directions, none of them close the full loop of automated, self-evolving strategy refinement. To bridge this gap, we introduce SR-Agent, a Strategy Refinement agentic framework that, to the best of our knowledge, is the first deployed for refining post-ranking strategies in industrial RS. SR-Agent unifies three components: (i) a UserSim agent that applies staged inspection skills to surface user-perceived bad cases; (ii) an Analysis agent that consolidates recurring bad cases into structured, reusable diagnoses; and (iii) a constrained Strategy Refinement Harness that maps diagnoses to typed and bounded actions, gated by a four-stage reward pipeline with reversible rollback. Deployed on the Kuaishou e-commerce platform, SR-Agent continuously runs this refinement loop and, in a one-month online A/B test, increases order volume by 0.71%, browsing depth by 0.34%, and clicked-category diversity by 0.48%, while markedly shortening the refinement cycle and lowering operational cost.
2607.17719.paper_summary_zh: 使用者體驗是工業電子商務推薦系統（RS）中的首要目標。後排名策略在工業 RS 中被廣泛應用，因為它們簡單且成本低廉，這些策略管理著排名列表中的多樣性、相似性和曝光率。然而，隨著在線推薦環境的不斷演變，這些靜態配置的策略逐漸變得過時，降低了使用者體驗。精煉這些策略通常依賴於手動檢查、診斷和更新，這一過程緩慢、成本高且難以重用。儘管最近的基於 LLM 的代理（例如 RecUserSim、SimUSER 和 Self-EvolveRec）提供了有希望的方向，但它們都未能實現自動化、自我演變策略精煉的完整循環。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了 SR-Agent，一個策略精煉代理框架，據我們所知，這是首個部署於工業 RS 中以精煉後排名策略的框架。SR-Agent 統一了三個組件：（i）一個 UserSim 代理，應用分階段檢查技能來揭示使用者感知的壞案例；（ii）一個分析代理，將重複出現的壞案例整合成結構化、可重用的診斷；以及（iii）一個受限的策略精煉工具，將診斷映射到類型化和有界的行動，並通過一個具有可逆回滾的四階段獎勵管道進行控制。SR-Agent 部署在快手電子商務平台上，持續運行這一精煉循環，在為期一個月的在線 A/B 測試中，訂單量增加了 0.71%、瀏覽深度增加了 0.34%、點擊類別的多樣性增加了 0.48%，同時顯著縮短了精煉週期並降低了運營成本。
